newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-NatWest focus on growth potential.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-NatWest focus on growth potential.

text.p: British banking group National Westminster Bank Plc said on Thursday that its new business unit NatWest Wealth Management would better enable it to tap the potential of the private banking, long-term savings and investments market.
Natwest group chief executive Derek Wanless told Reuters that the business offered "potentially very strong growth" for the group but declined to be more specific.
"It's a market with major growth potential because of demographic changes, peoples' need to save for sicknesss and old age," said Wanless.
